notes.title: Super Life "Franchise Lord" Update
notes.content:
Super Life continues in my new game 'Franchise Lord'! A franchise management sim set in the world of Super Life. This game was born at the request of the fans in the official Discord Server. With this next entry on the horizon, I thought I could use some of my new art to make minor adjustments to 'Super Life RPG'!
 
Wishlist 'Super Life Franchise Lord' on steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828320/Super_Life_Franchise_Lord/

Highlighted Changes
1.	Updated fast travel locations for all jobs
 
Updated Items
1.	Added possible meatball spaghetti 'Possible Pasta' at Luigis!
2.	Updated pill bottles (Energy/Sleeping/Heart/Adderall)
3.	Added 'Big Stack' to Angus McBangus menu
4.	Added new subs and chips Slimmy Sam's and Sub Bae
5.	Added more chip types to vending machines
6.	Added brownie to Tegrity Farms 
   
Bug Fixes
1.	Fixed rock potion bug
2.	Fixed Stadium Collison 
3.	Various other reported issues

notes.title: Super Life Complete Edition
notes.content:
Highlighted Features:
1.	Updated lighting and shadows
2.	Player icon now displayed on haste map
3.	Character and soccer balls can now be seen through objects
 
Save System:
1.	Added new save slot system
2.	Added cloud saves
3.	Reduced number of times the game saves to disk
 
Prestige Changes:
1.	Perma perks now match base perks currency/stat increase
2.	Dic now auto levels player +5/prestige (Max of Level 20)
3.	Bank open level 1 after first prestige
4.	Prestige Base klick coin bonus increased to 10K
 
Balance Changes:
1.	Drastically reduced level progression requirments.
2.	Money tree bags now payout higher
3.	Increased job bonuses
4.	Buffed eggs price
5.	Coffee and Expresso at home now give 10INT and more energy
6.	Reduced cost of ranches and candy equipment.
7.	Buffed candy production rate
8.	Increased cost of potions from Mr. Goatman
9.	Chests in maze now give 5000 klick coins each
10.	XP potion now grants 500 XP
11.	All challenges are now worth 10K klick coins
12.	Increased various secrets klick coin rewards
13.	Increase Gryff klick coin rewards after each time you find him
14.	Reduced job XP and degree requirements
 
New Degree Requirments:
•	SVCC (A 100)
•	Culinary (B 150 / M 300)
•	Computer Science (B 250 / M 500)
•	Medical (B 200 / M 400 / D 800)
 
Space Blasters:
1.	Increased fire rate
2.	Increased number of gems/powerups that spawn each wave
3.	Increased gold ship to 5000 points
4.	Display high score on main menu
 
Sewer Levels:
1.	Updated controls and air friction
2.	Slowed platforms and rats speed
3.	Skip level if you die more than 20 times
 
Dog:
1.	Buffed XP for playing with dog
2.	Dog treat now counts as food as well as happiness
3.	Display dog treat and days alive
 
Skins:
1.	Added Gender and Pear skins to skin select menu
2.	Wearing Pizza King shirt counts as being worthy
3.	Display speed 8 while wearing page 3 skins
4.	Skin now displayed in populous/farmbook pfp
 
Tweaks:
1.	Increased base movement speed
2.	Computers now have unique static backgrounds.
3.	Added time for secret races
4.	Increased odds of getting unicorn FrApe
5.	Soccer ball is always worth 25XP
6.	Watch soccer games earlier in day at FU
7.	Hospitals now have 6hr shifts
8.	Burgers now count as sammiches
9.	Added 3 collectable task stars
10.	Stadium hotel no longer needs VIP pass
11.	Golden ticket icon now displayed over klick ink on mini map
12.	Legalize any time after day 420
13.	Don't have to complete Dustin quest to open his garage
14.	Truck breaks down half as often
15.	Plane tickets now all cost 10 klick coins
16.	Cash is displayed in GS after you buy the ranch or train station
 
Fixes:
1.	Fixed dialog and text issues
2.	Updated various collision boxes
3.	Improved performance and texture quality in potato mode
4.	Compressed game file and made global optimizations

notes.title: 1.5 "ENDGAME" Update
notes.content:
Highlighted Feature:
	• Added new endgame city "Pineapple Island" aka "Isla Piña"

New Features:
	• 20 New Challenges (Steam Achievements)
	• 9 new quest NPCs
	• Various other NON-Quest NPC's
	• New jobs
	• New activities
	• New items
	• New secrets
	• Final 2 pendants
	• Final 2 skins
	• Final "Hunt"

QoL Improvements:
	• Added "Quest Log" in Populous 
	• Added new ability to time stone
	• Populous now displays all deeds
	• Added Friend Coins to Farmbook
	• New Dog Sitter NPC in Golden Springs
	• Added pet food at the vet
	• New items have been added to help players complete minigames

Tweaks:
	• Casino Tournaments now grant Klick Coin rewards
	• Keeping your dog alive grants Klick Coin rewards
	• Elon now requires finding HIS laptop
	• Alicia is now on the friend's list
	• Increased max candy mixers to 10
	• Removed job lock from bobs and city sushi
	• Slightly increased needed STR and INT early game
	• Increased late-game requirements
	• Made small changes and fixes to old quests
	• Updated several particle effects (Fire and Portals)
	• Nerfed XP needed for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
	• Buffed work bonuses
	• Buffed money tree bags
	• Buffed beef cows slightly
	• Buffed task rewards payout
	• Buffed farmbook app corn payout
	
Bugs:
	• Fixed bug were cows reproduced asexually
	• Fixed Helicopter collision
	• Fixed lighting issues with NPCs that leave on events
	• Fixed needs energy display
	• Fixed broken "i" buttons
	• Fixed Typos and various other bug fixes

Space Blasters:
	• Added "Tournaments" that reward you for getting higher scores
	• Slightly increased rate of fire

This is it the final* update I hope it has been an enjoyable ride! This game is the best thing I have ever done… so far. I am turning my attention to bigger things, but I am extremely happy with the success of Super Life and I can't wait to make another game in the franchise!

*I will still put out small patches when I get the chance.

notes.title: 1.2 Back to the Ranch Update
notes.content:
Highlighted Feature:
	• Added new town "Golden Springs"

New Features:
	• 10 new quest NPCs
	• New jobs
	• New school and gym
	• New mini game
	• New daily actions
	• New special events
	• New items
	• New secrets
	• New "Hunt"
	• Rebalanced level and task systems
	• Minor and major bug fixes
	• DOGS!

QoL Improvements:
	• Soft Reset - Reset your game without being level 100 and still keep your coins and prestige. 
	• Prestige - Now you can prestige each class 10 times
	• Added controller support (PC)
	• Added volume settings

Other notable changes:
	• All players start with $200 (Rich still get bonus $2K)
	• Grandpas Ranch updated to match ranch in Golden Springs
	• Coin Miners are now restricted to 10/Prestige However if you have over the limit your miners will NOT be reset
	• Space Blasters has received many small changes including 3 seconds of invulnerability after death
	• Bank in now locked until level 3
	• Reduced requirements to earn degrees
	• Mouse cursor size has been increased to help with controller gameplay
	• Coffee beans will now be consumed while you sleep if you own a coffee pot
	• Alcohol is no longer all created equal - some drinks will make you pass out sooner than others
	• Removed Adderall and Protein from gold boxes
	• 23 Hour fitness - increased STR gains after level 20
	• Home Gym has been buffed drastically
	• Most Jobs offer more XP and Careers now go up 2XP per promotion
	• Many food items now grant more XP

As you can see I have been very busy, I hope you all enjoy this large update! Expect to see many bug fixes and small content updates in the next few months!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

All Users: If you are under level 20 I recommend using the "Soft Reset" to get the new level stat requirements. The game has been rebalanced to play much faster so getting those levels back should not be an issue. 

Mac Users: I found a bug with the controller support that was crashing the Mac build. I have decided because 94% of players are on PC that I need to launch the update as is. I apologize to all Mac users but I will look into and try to get controller support on Mac in the future.

notes.title: 1.1.9 Meatball Plate Update
notes.content:
That is all I added, a plate of meatballs at Mykea… seriously.

So why is this update 200MB?

I am glad you asked. I would like to formally announce I have begun working on a free expansion for Super Life (RPG)! Many new 3D models, textures and other art assets have already been added to this build for testing purposes. I will be announcing more info about this expansion on the Super Life discord channel in September! 

Version 1.1.9 also includes many small bug fixes.
